story.titleZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1：博亚从P5起步冲刺赛
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1车队发帖称，马里·博亚在昨日排位赛取得生涯最佳成绩，正赛将从P4发车，今早冲刺赛则从P5起步。

story.summaryEn:
Starting with a Sprint.
Following a career-best Qualifying result yesterday, putting him in P4 for tomorrow, @MariBoya64 lines up P5 for this morning’s Sprint.
Vamos, Mari! 
#AzerbaijanGP
detailZh:
以冲刺赛开始。
在昨天取得生涯最佳排位赛成绩、让他明天从P4发车之后，@MariBoya64 今早的冲刺赛将从P5起步。
加油，马里！
#AzerbaijanGP
detailEn:
Starting with a Sprint.
Following a career-best Qualifying result yesterday, putting him in P4 for tomorrow, @MariBoya64 lines up P5 for this morning’s Sprint.
Vamos, Mari! 
#AzerbaijanGP
